newsitem.title: TURKEY: Eregli '96 steel output at 2,621,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Eregli '96 steel output at 2,621,000 T.

text.p: Turkey's leading flat steel producer Eregli Demir ve Celik Fabrikalari T.A.S. said its output reached a record high of 2,621,000 tonnes in 1996 while sales totalled 2,517,000 tonnes, also a record.
In a statement sent to the Istanbul stock exchange, Eregli said exports made up 502,000 tonnes of the total 1996 sales.
The previous production and sale records were 1994's 2,115,000 and 2,145,000 tonnes, respectively.
The company's output was down at 1,633,000 tonnes in 1995 due to investments which required some mills to be shut down and 1995 sales also fell to 1,711,000 tonnes.
Eregli recently completed a $1.5 billion capacity increase and modernisation programme which was started in 1989 to raise annual capacity to a minimum of 3.3 million tonnes from two.
